name: Report to Goldshire

angles.text: As a human, your move from Northshire to Goldshire is your first real recognition from Stormwind's military.
With Stormwind's army sent elsewhere, Elwynn's defense rests more and more on newly deputized recruits and volunteers like you.

faq.answer: Marshal Dughan commands the Stormwind Marshals in Goldshire. He oversees Elwynn Forest's defenses and patrols.
When recruits have dealt with trouble in Northshire Valley, Marshal McBride sends those who prove capable south to Goldshire. The dangers there stretch across all of Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Why are recruits sent to Goldshire?

faq.answer: Acting Deputy is a field rank granted with Marshal McBride's papers. It brings promising recruits into the Stormwind Marshals to help keep the law.
faq.q: What does Acting Deputy Status mean?

faq.answer: Marshal Dughan says most of Stormwind's standing army is away. The court nobles keep it busy with their duties instead of patrolling the towns and farms at home.
Marshal McBride commands the garrison at Northshire Abbey. He trains new defenders and sends those who prove themselves to the front line at Goldshire.
Follow the main road south out of Northshire Valley, past the border gates and into Elwynn Forest's heart. Goldshire lies along the road.
faq.q: How do you find Goldshire from Northshire?

sections.body: You've proved yourself against Northshire's troubles, and McBride releases you from the valley's guard. His transfer papers send you past the border gates and down the road to Goldshire. From there, your duty reaches across the wider forest.
sections.title: From Northshire to the Greater Forest

sections.body: Marshal Dughan waits in Goldshire to receive McBride's dispatches and make you an Acting Deputy of the Stormwind Marshals. His welcome carries a grim warning: beside the dangers roaming Elwynn, Northshire is a peaceful garden. Stormwind's royal army is bound up in distant nobles' politics, instead of guarding home ground.
sections.title: The Burden of the Marshals

summary: Marshal McBride sends you south to Goldshire with dispatches for Marshal Dughan. Beyond Northshire's sheltered valley, Stormwind's nobles give Elwynn Forest less and less thought.
attribution: In-game quest text: Report to Goldshire
